verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a first-party Audit Logs product that captures notable user actions as a compliance and security paper trail, with guides to emit and export events. Its pricing lists paid 'Log streaming (per SIEM connection)' for audit-log export, which covers the capture and stream-to-SIEM core of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence that logs are tamper-evident (immutability or integrity guarantees), detail on whether authentication and admin events are captured automatically rather than emitted by the developer, in-depth SIEM streaming docs beyond a pricing line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
